workouts.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

templates.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

templateFolders.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

goals.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

customExercises.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

programs.description: Rows the account owns in this collection.

MeProfile.description: `GET /me`: who a token acts as, and how much history there is to read.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable: branch on this.

retryAfter.description: Seconds, on a 429; also the Retry-After header.

share.description: The share of a set each of these muscles receives, when the library says it differs from the role's default (`primaryShare`, `secondaryShare`); null otherwise.

id.description: The identity: the server row's uuid, or the client-minted UUIDv7 for a custom exercise created offline (the server persists that id on sync).

key.description: The env-stable content slug (`bench-press-barbell`) for library exercises; null for user-created ones.

name.description: Localized display copy for the locale the library was fetched under — never an identifier.

aliases.description: Other names lifters search this exercise by in the served locale (`ohp`, `skull crusher`).

restTimer.description: The requesting user's preferred rest timer (seconds) for this exercise.

share.description: The weight as a share of the exercise's base in a program, a training max (heart-api#86): 0.85 is 85%.

of.description: Whose base `share` is a share of: another exercise's id (the front squat at 60% of the squat's training max).

ofSlot.description: Which occurrence of `of` the share is of, when the lift has a base per slot: a template exercise id, the volume day at 90% of the intensity day's squat (heart-api#257).

rir.description: Reps in reserve: stop with this many left in the tank.

set_type.description: The `set_type` word a write carries: `setType`'s value, or, when the set arrived with a word this build doesn't know, that word untouched.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion as the lifter rated it: 1–10 in whole or half points, null when not rated.

met.description: Measured MET (kcal/kg/h) over this exercise's time window, computed on device from wearable data.

note.description: A short, user-authored pin describing how this exercise is performed — e.g. "do one hand at a time".

rest.description: Rest between sets, in seconds, as a template plans it: 2–3 minutes for a compound lift, 60–90 seconds for isolation work.

superset.description: The superset this exercise belongs to in its session: exercises with the same number are done back to back, a circuit when there are more than two.

pattern.description: An open slot: any exercise of this movement pattern (a library key such as `vertical_pull`) will do, `exercise` being the one offered.

MeWorkout.description: A workout as the `/me` surface publishes it: the app's wire shape, minus what only the app's own plumbing needs.

calories.description: Estimated energy for the session in kilocalories: MET × body weight × time, from the exercises' catalog MET values and a weight the user typed in.

note.description: A free-text note on the whole session, trimmed; null when there is none.

templateId.description: The template this workout was started from, if any: a program's session or a plain template.

programId.description: The program this workout counts toward, if any.

MeWorkoutChanges.description: `GET /me/workouts/changes`: one page of the change feed.

cursor.description: Where to resume: pass it back as `since`.

hasMore.description: True when this page was cut short: ask again straight away.

MeExerciseSession.description: One session in an exercise's history: its workout, when, the working sets as they were done, and the values the progress chart plots for it (`toSessionMetrics`).

metrics.description: What the progress chart plots, by chart.

reason.description: One of `AnomalyReason`, or a word a newer server added.

setId.description: The set, for every reason but `durationLeftRunning`.

additionalProperties.description: Not declared yet: what was entered, by field

observed.description: What was entered when it was judged, in stored units: `weight` (kg) and `reps` for a set, `seconds` for a workout.

typical.description: The exercise's median working weight, kg, the set was judged against.

MeRecords.description: `GET /me/records`: personal records per exercise, as `toPersonalRecords` computes them — the same records the app shows.

id.description: The identity: the server row's uuid, or the client-minted UUIDv7 for a custom exercise created offline (the server persists that id on sync).

name.description: Localized display copy for the locale the library was fetched under — never an identifier.

MeLibrarySearch.description: Library search results: the exercises `SearchMatch` ranks best first, then by name, archived ones left out.

token.description: A personal access token from the app.
